stills.name: camber-straight
stills.caption: One second into the race, the ship runs 8th on the opening straight at 118 km/h with the rivals ahead.

clips.name: camber-title-menu
clips.caption: In the title menu TRACK steps from LAGOON to FURNACE and GLACIER and round to LAGOON again, and the live scene behind the menu moves to each track in turn.

clips.name: camber-start
clips.caption: The light counts down to GO! and the ship sets off in 8th place behind the seven rivals, out under the chequered banner.

clips.name: camber-carve-lap
clips.caption: R held carves the ship through a long right bend while the heat marks beside the shield light up; let go, the sling pushes it past a rival on the next straight.

clips.name: camber-tunnel
clips.caption: On FURNACE the road runs into a tunnel through the rock; the ship flies through the dark inside and out into the red desert again.

clips.name: camber-jump
clips.caption: On GLACIER a boost pad sends the ship at the jump; it flies over the gap beside the rivals and lands in 6th place.

stills.name: hairpin-pack
stills.caption: The kart races in the pack beside the lake and the birch trees at 104 km/h.

clips.name: hairpin-start
clips.caption: The start light counts down to GO and the kart sets off from 5th place on the RESERVOIR course, under the start banner and up the straight after the pack.

clips.name: hairpin-left-bend
clips.caption: A left bend in 1st place on lap 1: the kart brakes on the straight before it, takes the bend past the chevron boards and comes out on the straight after it.

clips.name: hairpin-summit
clips.caption: On the SUMMIT course the kart brakes for a right hairpin marked with chevron boards in the snow, turns round it and drives on through the pines.

stills.name: kestrel-gate
stills.caption: The craft lines up with gate 2 of mission 1, with loose rocks around it.

clips.name: kestrel-gate-run
clips.caption: The craft flies through gate 2 of mission 1 and on towards gate 3 among the rocks.

clips.name: kestrel-rock-hit
clips.caption: A loose rock strikes the craft (HULL HIT) and the hull drops from 3 to 2; the craft flies on through gate 7 of mission 1.

clips.name: kestrel-docking
clips.caption: The craft flies into the gold dock gate at the end of mission 1, and the CARGO DELIVERED card shows the gates, time cells, hull, time left and score.

stills.name: drive3d-bend
stills.caption: The car slides through the right bend after the ford at 56 km/h, throwing up dust from the gravel.

clips.name: drive3d-crest-ford
clips.caption: Full throttle on gravel: over the crest, down the drop towards the river and through the ford, the wheels pushing the water aside.

clips.name: drive3d-bend-slide
clips.caption: Out of the ford into the right bend: the car slides sideways on the gravel and throws up dust.

clips.name: drive3d-max-start
clips.caption: The start of the run at MAX, the highest detail level: the car pulls away up the gravel road throwing dust, with the hills and trees drawn far ahead.
